GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package closes audit findings F01, F02, and F09. A shared trait is useful only when advertised support and all real effects pass through the same authoritative gateway.

Alternatives.Alternative: Expose CEF or CDP directly to features. Rejected because it bypasses portable resources, authority, and update compatibility.
Return success from unavailable policy adapters. Rejected because silent degradation invalidates security and readiness evidence.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The first exact semantic action set is chosen during planning from the smallest useful generated-feature scenario.
Permission prompt UI belongs to the trusted UI package; the gateway owns only synchronous fail-closed policy projection.

Scenarios.Scenario: A feature queries a page, navigation changes the document revision, and the subsequent action on the stale element is denied.
A backend lacks capture support; negotiation omits capture and invocation returns explicit Unsupported without affecting navigation.
